description: Qwen's multilingual speech recognition model on one DGX Spark, served by vLLM 0.32.0 exactly as the Qwen3-ASR README documents (`vllm serve` with the `vllm[audio]` extra). It answers the OpenAI transcription route, POST /v1/audio/transcriptions, in 28 languages that OpenAI's `language` parameter can name, and also answers chat completions with an audio_url. Uploads are limited by vLLM's defaults of 25 MiB and 600 seconds. Memory follows the creator's 0.8 engine fraction (the Qwen3-ASR README's qwen-asr-serve example, hardware unstated) and is an estimate until tried.
title: Qwen3-ASR 1.7B (vLLM, single Spark)
